field.label: Enable OFME Fleet Agent
field.help: Runs the agent as a supervised service. Enroll the firewall before enabling the service.

field.label: Platform URL
field.help: Base URL of the OFME control plane, for example https://ofme.example.com. The agent appends /api/v1 unless the URL already ends with it.

field.label: Enrollment token
field.help: One-time token created in OFME under Zero-touch provisioning. It is cleared automatically after a successful enrollment.

field.label: Verify platform TLS certificate
field.help: Keep enabled. Disable only for the initial bootstrap against a platform that uses a private CA, then import the CA below and re-enable verification.

field.label: HTTPS proxy
field.help: Optional proxy URL, for example http://proxy.example.com:3128. Leave empty for a direct connection.

field.label: Heartbeat interval (seconds)
field.help: How often telemetry is published. The platform advertises its preferred interval during enrollment; this value is clamped to 15-3600 seconds.

field.label: Configuration poll interval (seconds)
field.help: How often the desired configuration is fetched. Changes are only applied when the matching apply switch is enabled.

field.label: Renew certificate before (days)
field.help: The agent requests a renewed certificate when the remaining lifetime drops below this threshold.

field.label: Request timeout (seconds)
field.help: Connect and read timeout for calls to the platform.

field.label: Apply managed aliases
field.help: Creates, updates and removes only aliases whose description starts with OFME- (the trailing hyphen is required by OPNsense). All other aliases are left untouched.

field.label: Apply managed firewall rules
field.help: Applies only firewall rules tagged OFME- and reloads the filter afterwards. Requires apply_aliases for rules that reference managed aliases. Review the preview before enabling this on production firewalls.

field.label: Log level
field.help: Debug logging includes request identifiers and command results.
